components.content:
Section 8: Billing Agency/Agent Information

Complete this section if you use a billing agency or billing agent to prepare and/or submit your Medicare claims.

NOTE: A billing agency/agent is a company or individual that you contract with to prepare and/or submit your claims. If you use a billing agency/agent, that agency/agent must comply with all Medicare rules and regulations, including 42 C.F.R. 424.80 which limits the circumstances under which a billing agency/agent may receive payment on your behalf.

components.label: This section does not apply (I do not use a billing agency/agent) - skip to Section 12
If you are changing information about your current billing agency/agent, or adding or removing a billing agency/agent, check the applicable box and furnish the effective date
